mapper.sql: select s.session_id as "sessionId", u.user_id as "userId", u.login_id as "loginId", u.employee_no as "employeeNo", coalesce(kps.name, u.login_id) as "userName", coalesce(s.login_at, s.created_at) as "loginAt", s.last_accessed_at as "lastAccessedAt", s.ip_address as "ipAddress", s.status as "status", s.terminated_by as "terminatedBy", s.terminated_at as "terminatedAt", s.termination_reason as "terminationReason" from sessions s join users u on u.user_id = s.user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots kps on kps.employee_no = u.employee_no

sql.where:
s.status = 'ACTIVE' and s.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
and (u.login_id ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%') or kps.name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%') or s.ip_address ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%'))

mapper.sql: select h.history_id as "historyId", h.session_id as "sessionId", u.user_id as "userId", u.login_id as "loginId", u.employee_no as "employeeNo", coalesce(kps.name, u.login_id) as "userName", h.termination_type as "terminationType", h.termination_reason as "terminationReason", h.terminated_at as "terminatedAt" from session_termination_history h join sessions s on s.session_id = h.session_id join users u on u.user_id = s.user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots kps on kps.employee_no = u.employee_no

where.if: and (u.login_id ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%') or kps.name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%') or u.employee_no ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%') or h.session_id ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%'))

mapper.select: order by s.last_accessed_at desc, s.login_at desc, s.session_id limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from sessions s join users u on u.user_id = s.user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots kps on kps.employee_no = u.employee_no
where s.session_id = #{sessionId} for update of s
order by h.terminated_at desc, h.history_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select count(*) from session_termination_history h join sessions s on s.session_id = h.session_id join users u on u.user_id = s.user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots kps on kps.employee_no = u.employee_no
mapper.update: update sessions set status = 'TERMINATED', terminated_by = #{operatorUserId}, terminated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, termination_reason = #{reason}, last_accessed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where session_id = #{sessionId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: insert into session_termination_history (session_id, termination_type, termination_reason, terminated_at) values (#{sessionId}, 'ADMIN_TERMINATED', #{reason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

insert into business_process_audit_logs (action_type, target_key, before_state, after_state, actor_user_id, result_status, request_id) values ('SESSION_TERMINATE', #{sessionId}, '{"status":"ACTIVE"}'::jsonb, jsonb_build_object('status', 'TERMINATED', 'reason', #{reason}), #{operatorUserId}, 'SUCCESS', #{requestId})
